profile.name: Lucas Schmidt
profile.summary: Building production Flutter apps since 2020. Today: healthcare apps at Pulsati, one with 100K+ downloads. Before that, the sole mobile developer at a logistics operator and a software engineer on hospital systems at Philips. Open to remote roles.

roles.title: Software Engineer · Mobile
roles.summary: Healthcare apps for health plans, hospitals and dental clinics in Flutter, plus React and Java when the feature needs it. Biometric login, scheduling, exam results; patient data protected under LGPD. Code review and mentoring.

roles.title: Software Engineer · Mobile — sole mobile developer
roles.summary: Chose the architecture for and shipped the company-wide employee app. Rebuilt media upload in native Kotlin. Maintained the shared internal plugin behind every Tecadi app.

roles.title: Software Engineer · Mobile — own studio
roles.summary: Built a spaced-repetition English learning app over 8 months with a Python back-end developer: review scheduling, teacher dashboards and offline study. Used by ~100 students on Android and iOS.

roles.title: Software Engineer — Tasy hospital system
roles.summary: Radiology and laboratory modules. Rebuilt a lab-analyzer integration within a 1-week deadline, refactored ~20 crash-prone screens to run 10–20 s faster. Became the team's go-to for refactoring legacy code and wrote its clean code guide.
